purpose: Make every quality judgment useful for improving the work. The desired score is a target, never an instruction to alter an honest assessment.
requiredForEveryScore: Named deductions and their effect on the experience
What observable improvement could change the score
unknown: Use null / not yet scored when evidence is insufficient. Missing evidence is not an invented defect; a technical pass is not proof of artistic excellence.
individuality: Keep each of the 18 judgments. Pair and team agreement concerns the work plan and criteria, not mandatory identical numbers. Do not hide a lower score inside an average.
nineTarget: A reviewer can award 9 or above only after relevant improvements and fresh evidence justify it in that reviewer’s stated scope. A roadmap agreement does not award the future score.
audienceClaims: Separate expert design judgment, usability observations, owner preference and actual human recognition/attachment/recall evidence. Do not claim one substitutes for another.
consensus: Every reviewer explicitly agrees, agrees with named nonblocking limits, or objects with evidence. Investigate substantive objections. Record dissent if unresolved; never fabricate unanimity.
scope: Current V5 character, motion, identity applications and review studio. Future website/world scenes remain later. Optional sound remains optional.
